messages:
maya: heads-up — running into a few oddities integrating python sdk streaming + auth. Two quick things:
1) when setting client quiet/disable-telemetry we still see a User-Agent like 'Redwood-Python/...' on requests — are we leaking internal UA?
2) retry behavior: auth token refresh + streaming chunk reconnects — should retries send telemetry?
TL;DR: how to fully opt-out per-request and ensure tracing propagation doesn't break reconnects? cc @sam

sam: pinging @devex — this is probably the headers/telemetry flags we discussed last sprint. @qi did we land per-request opt-out?

qi: quick answer: per-request opt-out exists through `Client(telemetry=False)` and per-call `client.generate(..., telemetry=False)` in py sdk. But streaming path has edge case — reconnects spin up a new http session that re-adds default UA unless you pass headers explicitly.

maya: can you show example? I need to ensure enterprise customers can disable client metrics completely (legal req).

qi: sure. gist:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="...", telemetry=False, default_headers={"User-Agent": ""})
with client.stream(..., telemetry=False, headers={"User-Agent": ""}) as s:
    ...
```
Note: for token refresh retries you also need to set `client.session.headers.update({"User-Agent": ""})` before first request.

andre: heads-up — don't set UA to empty string for some proxies (they reject empty UA). Recommended to set a minimal sentinel like `User-Agent: Redwood-Client` or honor customer's header if present.

maya: ah cool — ok to send 'Redwood-Client/optout' ?

andre: yep that's what we used in enterprise pilot: `Redwood-Client/optout`

deploy-bot: rolled out telemetry opt-out fix to python sdk canary (v0.9.3-canary) — release notes https://go/redwood/release/0.9.3-canary

qi: extra note on tracing propagation: if app passes `traceparent`/`baggage` in headers we won't overwrite. But internal reconnects may lose context if the streaming client re-creates connection after auth refresh. Workaround: attach tracer ctx to client via `client.inject_trace_context(tracer.get_current())` or pass `headers={'traceparent': ...}` on reconnect.

maya: thanks. For retries: should retransmitted chunks include telemetry? lawyers want telemetry zero for these enterprise accounts even on retry.

sam: policy: if `telemetry=False` on client or call, no telemetry events or metrics should be emitted anywhere (telemetry pipeline skip). For now SDK ensures no telemetry logs are sent, but the request headers may still carry UA unless you explicitly override. Filing a follow-up to ensure headers also suppressed for retry/reconnect. @qi I'll need a tiny patch to session reconstructor.

qi: agreed — I'll add session header inheritance to canary and add tests. ETA EOD. filing PR #2345

maya: perfect, thanks team :thumbsup:
